articles.summary: CAYCE, S.C. (Aug. 14, 2026) – With potentially record-breaking high temperatures across the Palmetto State today and into next week, Dominion Energy is offering a few practical tips to beat the heat and save energy as air conditioning systems work around the clock to keep homes comfortable. "Customers may be surprised to see their bill increase even when they haven’t adjusted their thermostat or changed their daily routines,” said Gerald Freeman, program manager of Dominion Energy South Carolina’s Home Energy Checkup program. “Any setting below 78 when outdoor temperatures are in the triple digits will cause your HVAC system to work harder just to keep up. We want to make sure customers know what they can do to manage their energy usage as we approach the hottest days of the summer so far.” Follow these five tips for conserving energy this summer, and visit DominionEnergy.com/Save for more energy-saving tips: Adjust thermostats to 78 degrees or higher when temperatures rise. articles.title: Dominion Energy Offers Tips to Manage Summer Bills as Temperatures Soar

Crews began work in January 2024 to replace headgates inside each of the Saluda Hydroelectric Project’s five intake towers and reconstruct brick enclosures atop each tower. articles.summary: Grants support human needs, environmental stewardship, education and community vitality Cayce, S.C. (Aug. 12, 2026) – Nonprofit organizations within Dominion Energy's service areas are invited to apply for grants from the Dominion Energy Charitable Foundation. Grants will be awarded to support programs and specific projects that focus on human needs, environmental stewardship, education and community vitality.
